name: Cheryl's Bahamas Taxi and Tours
primary_cta: Book my pickup / Send my day
brand_truth: Cheryl's driver is the one in navy and yellow holding a card with your name at Nassau arrivals.
buyer: Cruise passengers and resort guests (US, families, Spanish speakers) booking a Nassau airport ride or a private tour on a phone, afraid of being left at the airport or overpaying.

direction.type: T06 Wide grotesk (Syne variable 600-800 lowercase + Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/700)
direction.why: P14 deep blue and yellow are Cheryl's own uniform colours; a poster with a sign you put your name on is the brand truth; the ticket block is their real JotForm transfer booking; the dock keeps Pickup, Tours, Call under the thumb.

tier_why: A taxi and private tour operator: the product is a person holding your name and a day on the island, best shown with their own photos and an interaction, not real-time 3D.
concept_type: booking: two paths on screen 1 (airport pickup with live name card, private tour); 3-step pickup ticket with every JotForm field; tour builder on a real New Providence coastline map with all 22 sourced stops, auto-ordered route drawing, driving estimate and stated entry fees, sending a prefilled email

current_site_findings: Covid 19 banner still at the top
five phone numbers, no clear one
off-brand JotForm booking with 200-country list and timezone picker
pitch_line: Your guests already remember one thing about you: their name on your card at arrivals. This site starts there, books the ride in one ticket and lets them build a tour from your 22 stops.
assumptions: Tour presets (3-hour: forts, straw market, Cloisters; full day: forts, Love Beach, conch) are suggestions based on the two sample tours on their site
Forms send by email (no WhatsApp number was found)
Atkinson Hyperlegible draws a slashed zero by design
Map pin positions are approximate (placed by us); Exuma trips are shown leaving the map
Driving km and minutes are a planning estimate (straight line x 1.35 at 32 km/h), labelled as such
Entry fee totals use only prices stated on their site (forts $3-5 pp, conch $10 a bowl sharing 4, Ardastra $18 pp, Pieces of 8 $400/$365); other stops are quoted by Cheryl's
notes: 2026-11-21 job-spec rebuild (approved spec). Screen 1: two paths (pickup with name-card field and flight; private tour with start area and presets) beside their own team photo and a live arrivals name card; generated arrivals photo removed. Kept and elevated: 3-step pickup ticket with all JotForm fields, both sample days, 22 stops, one number day or night. New: tour builder on a real geoBoundaries coastline, auto-ordered route drawing with dashed sea legs, looping van, camera fit, stop card, km, driving estimate, stated fees, Send my day drawer; phone sticky map + bottom bar. Palette moved from teal to their navy #14254a + yellow. BLIND: outside photos could not load in the sandbox; critic judged placement. qa 0 blockers; interact 0 JS errors; distinct: closest unexso 61. Critic pass 1 composition 3; after fix pass 2 all lines 4. Follow-ups: phone map labels crowd in the downtown cluster and the Blue Lagoon label can clip at the right edge; Atkinson Hyperlegible draws slashed zeros by design.
